column3: Summary The Fund returned 2.9% in the third quarter, ahead of its policy benchmark by 0.4 percentage points. Gains came mainly from global equities and infrastructure, while government bonds were broadly flat. The funding ratio improved from 94.3% to 96.1% over the quarter.
